messages:
deploy-bot: Starting silent cutover canary for catalog change: enabling model 'loris-7b-quant' (canary 5%) across hosted and dedicated lanes. changelist: https://redwood.internal/release/2299 
leila: ack - quiet window 01:00-03:00 UTC, operations will monitor. will pin legacy variant for Enterprise customers.
raj: quick q — what's fallback ordering? need to ensure low-cost variant first for heavy embedding workloads.
simon: fallback order proposed: loris-7b-quant -> loris-7b-q4 -> orion-3b-quant. i've set capacity reservations in us-west1 and eu-west1 but eu-west1 is tight (~87% GPU usage).
leila: add rollback criteria: error rate >1.5% sustained for 3m OR 99p latency increase >700ms over baseline for 5m. also stepdown plan if cost-per-token jumps >25% for 10m.
amelia: can we pin loris-7b-q4 for customers in the ‘enterprise-sla’ tag? otherwise they might see the quant variant unexpectedly.
raj: yes, we should. command i'll run after approvals:
```
/release catalog enable --model=loris-7b-quant --canary=5% --fallback=loris-7b-q4,orion-3b-quant --pin=enterprise-sla --quiet
```
leila: thumbs up from me. add alert to pager if rollback triggers hit. metrics dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/rollout/2299
simon: note: routing policy will route traffic by geography to respect latency SLOs; eu-west forced to keep canary at 2% until capacity freed. ops-bot, can you confirm auto-fallback tiebreaker priority?
ops-bot: auto-fallback priority is: (1) per-route override, (2) pinned variants, (3) catalog priority map, (4) global default. logging set to include chosen-fallback in trace context.
amelia: also add an eval set run (sanity prompts) after canary start — want to detect regression on codegen snippets. i'll push prompts to the eval job.
raj: starting canary now in quiet mode. i'll post progress every 5m.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: 5% traffic, targets: hosted,dedicated; monitoring: grafana/rollout-2299, traces: jaeger/2299.
leila: watching latency, error-rate and cost panels. all green first 2 minutes.
simon: seeing slight spike in eu-west1 95p latency (+120ms) on one replica group — i'm diverting canary traffic away from that host.
raj: divert done. canary still at 5%. no errors.
ops-bot: Reminder: emergency rollback command: `/release catalog rollback --thread=2299001234 --reason="safety"`. Keep on-call pager ready.
leila: keep canary running for 20m then increase to 20% if stable.
amelia: ran evals after start — small BLEU drop on one prompt (0.8 -> 0.76). not critical but flagging.
raj: noted. continuing. next check at +10m.
deploy-bot: Canary update: t+10m: errors 0.6%, 99p latency +90ms, cost +12%.
simon: eu-west host stabilized. capacity buffer now 12%.
leila: good to promote to 20% in next window if metrics remain steady.
amelia: i'll run a second eval sweep pre-promotion with extra codegen cases.
raj: if anything breaches rollback thresholds we execute staged rollback: 1) drop canary to 0% 2) pin previous production model globally 3) evacuate KV caches for the quant variant 4) follow postmortem template.
ops-bot: Noted. automated runbook will ping #eng-oncall and create ticket if rollback executed.
leila: thanks everyone. will update release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/release/2299/draft and ping sales for enterprise-comm.
deploy-bot: Canary still running. next automated update at t+20m.
